name: Analisis de metadatos
description: Comprehensive examination of EXIF, XMP, and IPTC data embedded in image files para detectar signs of AI generation tools. Analiza camera make/model, GPS coordinates, processing software, creation timestamps, and file structure to verify image autenticidad.
mechanism:
The análisis de metadatos system operates in multiple stages:

1. **Data Extraction**: Reads all EXIF (Exchangeable Image File Format), XMP (Extensible Metadata Platform), and IPTC (International Press Telecommunications Council) metadatos fields embedded in the image.

2. **Camera Verification**: Examina Make, Model, LensModel fields to verify the capture device. AI images typically lack or contain fabricated camera information.

3. **Software Detection**: Identifica Software, CreatorTool, HistorySoftwareAgent tags containing AI tool names como 'Stable Diffusion', 'DALL-E', 'Midjourney', 'Adobe Firefly'.

4. **Timestamp Validation**: Cross-references DateTimeOriginal, DateTimeDigitized, ModifyDate para detectar temporal anomalías.

5. **GPS Analysis**: Verifica GPSLatitude, GPSLongitude — AI images rarely contain authentic GPS coordinates.
parameters:
Primary EXIF fields: Make, Model, Software, GPSLatitude, GPSLongitude, DateTimeOriginal, ColorSpace, ExifVersion, XMP:CreatorTool, XMP:History, IPTC:DigitalSourceType

Detected AI tools: Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ComfyUI, Automatic1111, InvokeAI

Metadata standards: EXIF 2.32 (JEITA CP-3451), Adobe XMP 2.0, IPTC PMD 2024.1
accuracy: Alta - 85-95% when metadatos is present and unstripped. However, many social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram) automatically strip metadatos on upload, reducing effectiveness.
source: JEITA CP-3451 (Exif 2.32), Adobe XMP Specification, IPTC Photo Metadata Standard
useCase: First-pass triage: quickly identifica images with AI software tags, missing authentic camera metadatos, or inconsistent metadatos. This is the first step in the análisis pipeline due to its speed and low computational cost.

references.title: JEITA CP-3451C — Exchangeable Image File Format (Exif) Version 2.32
Adobe XMP Specification Part 1: Data Model, Serialization, and Core Properties
C2PA Technical Specification — Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity
Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2011). A Perceptual Metric for Photo Retouching. PNAS.
Gloe, T. & Böhme, R. (2010). The Dresden Image Database for Benchmarking Digital Image Forensics. ACM SAC.

strengths:
• Extremely fast análisis time (< 10ms per image)
• No pixel decoding required, only reads file headers
• High precisión when metadatos is intact
• Can identify specific AI tools through software tags
• Compliant with international standards (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, C2PA)
limitations:
• Metadata can be easily stripped or forged
• Many social media platforms auto-strip metadatos on upload
• Cannot detect AI images that have had metadatos removed
• Depends on whether AI tools embed software tags
